verdict.rationale: Medusa's GitHub README says its framework and modules can support PoS systems. Its Sales Channel, Inventory, Product and Customer-related commerce modules suggest a single shared backend that could serve both a POS channel and an online store. However, the evidence shows no ready-made point-of-sale app, so a merchant would have to build or integrate the POS front end themselves. Missing for 10: a first-party or documented POS application, explicit documentation of shared catalog/inventory/customers across in-person and online channels, in-person payment hardware support, and hands-on corroboration.
